sourceDelta.explanation: The exact Care 0.1.0 transition changed release identity, packaging, lifecycle qualification, and bounded window/header lifecycle copy. It did not change Care's Glaze V1.2/V1.3 style implementation, UI contract, focus/accessibility contract files, canonical icon, or runtime UI acceptance harness.

representativeExactCandidateEvidence.observationBasis: The exact 0.1.0 package was exercised on the representative Zorin OS 17.3 laptop for full package lifecycle acceptance and subsequently through the six prescribed real-desktop PolicyKit GUI checks. This current-device evidence is functional/representative confirmation; the seven predecessor Glaze human/native findings are not fabricated as newly rerun observations.

bridgeRationale.reason: The previously accepted seven-dimensional Glaze V1.2 human/native review is retained as predecessor evidence and bridged only because the exact-source delta is non-material to the governed Glaze implementation, icon, UI contract, focus/accessibility behavior, and acceptance harness. Lifecycle copy and package identity changed and were exercised on the exact representative candidate.

summary: GLAZE UI V1.2 accepted-v1 is explicitly bridged from the accepted frozen Care RC to exact Care 0.1.0. The bridge is exact-source/package bound, does not rewrite the predecessor human/native review, does not grant generic production eligibility, and does not independently authorize Care Stable promotion.
